title: Distinguishing activated T regulatory cell and T conventional cells by single-cell technologies.
authors: Reinhardt, Julia; Sharma, Virag; Stavridou, Antigoni; Lindner, Annett; Reinhardt, Susanne; Petzold, Andreas; Lesche, Mathias; Rost, Fabian; Bonifacio, Ezio; Eugster, Anne
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞RNA测序和机器学习区分Treg与Tconv细胞，但对象为免疫细胞分型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Resting conventional T cells (Tconv) can be distinguished from T regulatory cells (Treg) by the canonical markers FOXP3, CD25 and CD127. However, the expression of these proteins alters after T-cell activation leading to overlap between Tconv and Treg. The objective of this study was to distinguish resting and antigen-responsive T effector (Tconv) and Treg using single-cell technologies. CD4(+) Treg and Tconv cells were stimulated with antigen and responsive and non-responsive populations processed for targeted and non-targeted single-cell RNAseq. Machine learning was used to generate a limited set of genes that could distinguish responding and non-responding Treg and Tconv cells and which was used for single-cell multiplex qPCR and to design a flow cytometry panel. Targeted scRNAseq clearly distinguished the four-cell populations. A minimal set of 27 genes was identified by machine learning algorithms to provide discrimination of the four populations at >95% accuracy. In all, 15 of the genes were validated to be differentially expressed by single-cell multiplex qPCR. Discrimination of responding Treg from responding Tconv could be achieved by a flow cytometry strategy that included staining for CD25, CD127, FOXP3, IKZF2, ITGA4, and the novel marker TRIM which was strongly expressed in Tconv and weakly expressed in both responding and non-responding Treg. A minimal set of genes was identified that discriminates responding and non-responding CD4(+) Treg and Tconv cells and, which have identified TRIM as a marker to distinguish Treg by flow cytometry.
abstract_zh: 静息状态的常规T细胞（Tconv）可通过典型标志物FOXP3、CD25和CD127与调节性T细胞（Treg）区分。然而，T细胞激活后这些蛋白的表达发生变化，导致Tconv与Treg之间出现重叠。本研究旨在利用单细胞技术区分静息状态和抗原应答的T效应细胞（Tconv）及Treg。将CD4(+) Treg和Tconv细胞用抗原刺激，并对应答和非应答群体进行靶向及非靶向单细胞RNA测序。利用机器学习生成一组有限的基因，用于区分应答和非应答的Treg及Tconv细胞，并用于单细胞多重qPCR及设计流式细胞术方案。靶向scRNAseq清晰区分了四种细胞群体。通过机器学习算法识别出由27个基因组成的最小基因集，能够以>95%的准确率区分这四种群体。其中15个基因经单细胞多重qPCR验证为差异表达。通过包含CD25、CD127、FOXP3、IKZF2、ITGA4及新型标志物TRIM染色的流式细胞术策略，可实现应答Treg与应答Tconv的区分，其中TRIM在Tconv中强表达，在应答和非应答Treg中均弱表达。本研究识别出一个最小基因集，可区分应答和非应答的CD4(+) Treg及Tconv细胞，并确定TRIM为通过流式细胞术区分Treg的标志物。
